name: add_comm_vec
informal: Vector addition is commutative: v + w = w + v for all vectors in ℝⁿ.
lean_statement: theorem add_comm_vec (v w : Fin n → ℝ) : v + w = w + v
lean_proof: by ext i; exact add_comm (v i) (w i)

name: add_assoc_vec
lean_statement: theorem add_assoc_vec (u v w : Fin n → ℝ) : (u + v) + w = u + (v + w)
lean_proof: by ext i; exact add_assoc (u i) (v i) (w i)

name: zero_add_vec
informal: Zero vector is left identity: 0 + v = v.
lean_statement: theorem zero_add_vec (v : Fin n → ℝ) : 0 + v = v

name: add_neg_vec
informal: Every vector has an additive inverse: v + (-v) = 0.
lean_statement: theorem add_neg_vec (v : Fin n → ℝ) : v + (-v) = 0

name: smul_add_vec
informal: Scalar multiplication distributes over addition: c·(v+w) = c·v + c·w.
lean_statement: theorem smul_add_vec (c : ℝ) (v w : Fin n → ℝ) : c • (v + w) = c • v + c • w
lean_proof: by ext i; exact mul_add c (v i) (w i)

name: add_smul_vec
lean_statement: theorem add_smul_vec (c d : ℝ) (v : Fin n → ℝ) : (c + d) • v = c • v + d • v
lean_proof: by ext i; exact add_mul c d (v i)

name: smul_assoc_vec
lean_statement: theorem smul_assoc_vec (c d : ℝ) (v : Fin n → ℝ) : c • (d • v) = (c * d) • v

name: one_smul_vec
informal: 1·v = v (the unity law for scalar multiplication).
lean_statement: theorem one_smul_vec (v : Fin n → ℝ) : (1 : ℝ) • v = v

name: eigenvalue_id
informal: The identity map has eigenvalue 1: every nonzero vector is an eigenvector.
lean_statement: theorem eigenvalue_id (v : Fin n → ℝ) (hv : v ≠ 0) : (λ x : Fin n → ℝ => x) v = (1 : ℝ) • v

name: distrib_left_r
lean_statement: theorem distrib_left_r (x y z : ℝ) : x * (y + z) = x * y + x * z

name: neg_one_smul
lean_statement: theorem neg_one_smul (v : Fin n → ℝ) : (-1 : ℝ) • v = -v

name: zero_smul_vec
lean_statement: theorem zero_smul_vec (v : Fin n → ℝ) : (0 : ℝ) • v = 0

name: sub_eq_add_neg
lean_statement: theorem sub_eq_add_neg (v w : Fin n → ℝ) : v - w = v + (-w)

name: add_comm_r
informal: x + y = y + x for real numbers.
lean_statement: theorem add_comm_r (x y : ℝ) : x + y = y + x

name: mul_comm_r
lean_statement: theorem mul_comm_r (x y : ℝ) : x * y = y * x
